title: Escape Goats Escape Rooms
specs: Family friendly and safe escape room games
Participants can be of any age; parties with participants under 14 must include at least one participant over 18
Rooms designed for minimum 4 participants; if fewer than 4, must book by phone
Rooms accommodate up to 10 people (one room max 8); extra participants can pay at booking lobby
Special events and bookings outside normal hours available by request
includes: Private booking with no strangers in the room
blurb: Guests participate in hour-long escape room games designed for groups of 4 to 10 people. The rooms are family friendly and safe, with private bookings ensuring no strangers in the same room. Suitable for family fun, friends, or team building exercises.
extraNote: Full refunds if cancelled or rescheduled more than 48 hours before booking; no refunds within 48 hours
